summary: Wisekey International Holding S.A., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release from its subsidiary SEALSQ Corp reporting preliminary H1 2026 results. Revenue rose 120% to ~$11 million, with ~$495 million cash and short-term investments. The filing is a routine earnings update for a non-US issuer via Form 6-K, equivalent to an earnings release or 8-K item 2.02. No corporate event or special situation (merger, tender, activist, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed. No deal terms or strategic change announced; the filing solely communicates operational and financial performance.
